summary: The original inspector-navigation focus-loss defect is corrected, and no supported defect was found in the rapid selection/filter URL composition. One limited residual focus-request cancellation issue remains for pointer blur to non-focusable content.
limitations: This was a bounded follow-up to the original review, with the lead-provided correction rationale visible; it is not a new independent review of the whole feature.
No browsers, builds, tests or live data were executed. Runtime focus, exact loading timing and rapid input ordering remain owned by the separate integration lane.
The residual null-relatedTarget pointer-blur finding is source-derived and limited to focus returning from body; active form/dialog focus is protected by the current guard.
